name: audit-tools
description: Local MCP server exposing ADP/Paycom/Uzio payroll audit, census, withholding, prior-payroll, and consolidated-audit tools to Claude Desktop. Reads and writes files in a local Audit Files folder.
long_description: A local, stdio-only MCP server. Drop ADP/Paycom/Uzio exports into your Audit Files folder and ask Claude to run an audit; reports are written back to the same folder as timestamped .xlsx (and .csv for single-sheet outputs). No web server, no network surface — everything runs on your machine. See SETUP.md and CLAUDE.md for details.

audit_inbox.title: Audit Files folder
audit_inbox.description: Folder where you drop input exports and where reports are written. Defaults to your Desktop/Audit Files.

state_tax_master.title: State Tax Code master CSV (optional)
state_tax_master.description: Only needed for the 'adp_prior_payroll_setup_helper' tool. Leave blank if you don't use that tool; you can also pass the path to the tool directly.
